answer: A grove of identities grows only from proven work: each newcomer must finish a prism-split job, one task split into three parts, each checked by a different unrelated client who stakes 4 POA that the work was real. A fake that invents all three parts forfeits 12 POA, and the stake doubles per extra identity from the same funding wallet, so the 10th fake risks 6,144 POA while one honest agent risks 12. A plume of copied outputs earns nothing: identical work across identities is flagged and all linked bonds are slashed.
